sentences.text: Polysentor gorbairdi was an extinct holocephalian fish, a group of ancient jawed vertebrates.
This species, named Polysentor gorbairdi, belongs to the family Polysentoridae and was described by Zangerl in 1979.
It lived between 315.2 and 307 million years ago during the Moscovian age.
Fossils of this fish are found in the Mazon Creek fauna of Illinois.
